    return True
# Determine the block index (0-based) by integer division of position by 2

# Even blocks keep the color of the first card in the block,
# odd blocks require the opposite color.

    return True

if block % 2 == 0:
    return card.color == first_in_block.color
else:
    return card.color != first_in_block.color

rules_library.code:
if len(mainline) < 2:
    return True
prod_mod = (mainline[-1].rank * mainline[-2].rank) % 10
return (card.rank % 10) == prod_mod

rules_library.name: alternating_suit_pairs
rules_library.description: Suits must appear in pairs: first two cards hearts or diamonds, next two clubs or spades, then repeat.

rules_library.name: rank_diff_equals_suit_value
rules_library.description: Let hearts=1, diamonds=2, clubs=3, spades=4. The absolute rank difference from the previous card must equal the numeric value of the candidate’s suit.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
suit_value = {"hearts":1, "diamonds":2, "clubs":3, "spades":4}[card.suit.suit_name]
diff = abs(card.rank - mainline[-1].rank)
return diff == suit_value

rules_library.name: color_pattern_red_black_black
rules_library.description: Colors repeat in the three-card pattern: red → black → black → red → …

rules_library.name: triangular_ranks
rules_library.description: Only ranks that are triangular numbers (1, 3, 6, 10) may be played.
rules_library.code: return card.rank in (1, 3, 6, 10)

rules_library.name: perfect_number_rank
rules_library.description: Only the perfect number rank 6 is allowed.
rules_library.code: return card.rank == 6

rules_library.name: suit_matches_parity
rules_library.description: Even ranks must be black suits; odd ranks must be red suits.

rules_library.name: rank_equals_abs_diff_last_two
rules_library.description: If at least two cards are on the mainline, the new rank must equal the absolute difference of the two previous ranks.
rules_library.code:
if len(mainline) < 2:
    return True
diff = abs(mainline[-1].rank - mainline[-2].rank)
return card.rank == diff

rules_library.name: rank_equals_sum_last_two_mod13
rules_library.description: If at least two cards are on the mainline, the new rank must equal (sum of the last two ranks) modulo 13, treating 0 as 13.
rules_library.code:
if len(mainline) < 2:
    return True
s = (mainline[-1].rank + mainline[-2].rank) % 13
expected = 13 if s == 0 else s
return card.rank == expected

rules_library.name: repeat_three_suits
rules_library.description: Suits repeat every three cards in the order hearts → clubs → spades → hearts … (diamonds never appear).
rules_library.code:
order = ["hearts", "clubs", "spades"]
if not mainline:
    return True
expected = order[len(mainline) % 3]
return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules_library.name: rank_multiple_of_position_index
rules_library.description: The rank must be a multiple of the card’s position index in the mainline (1-based). For example, the 4th card must have a rank divisible by 4.
rules_library.code:
pos = len(mainline) + 1   # 1-based position where this card will be placed
return card.rank % pos == 0

rules_library.name: majority_color_rule
rules_library.description: If the mainline already contains more red than black cards, the next card must be red; if more black, it must be black; if tied, any color is allowed.

rules_library.name: rank_is_prime
rules_library.description: Only cards whose rank is a prime number (2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13) may be played.
rules_library.code:
primes = {2,3,5,7,11,13}
return card.rank in primes

rules_library.name: rank_is_composite
rules_library.description: Only cards whose rank is a composite number (4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12) may be played.
rules_library.code:
composite = {4,6,8,9,10,12}
return card.rank in composite

rules_library.name: rank_greater_than_last_by_at_least_3
rules_library.description: Each rank must be at least three higher than the previous rank; any card may start.

rules_library.name: same_color_two_back
rules_library.description: The card’s color must match the color of the card two positions earlier (if such a card exists).

rules_library.name: rank_is_multiple_of_4_or_5
rules_library.description: Only ranks that are multiples of 4 or 5 (4, 5, 8, 10, 12) may be played.
rules_library.code: return card.rank % 4 == 0 or card.rank % 5 == 0

rules_library.name: suit_must_be_hearts_if_last_is_red
rules_library.description: If the previous card is red, the next card must be hearts; otherwise any suit is allowed.

rules_library.name: rank_equals_number_of_cards_played_so_far
rules_library.description: The rank must equal the position in the sequence (1-based), cycling every 13 cards.
rules_library.code:
expected = (len(mainline) % 13) + 1
return card.rank == expected

rules_library.name: color_same_as_last_if_rank_even_else_opposite
rules_library.description: If the previous rank is even, the new card must keep the same color; if odd, the color must switch.

rules_library.name: alternating_suit_every_three
rules_library.description: The suit changes every three cards; the first three may be any suit, the next three must be a different suit, and so on.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
group = (len(mainline) // 3)          # which group of three we are in
if group == 0:
    return True
# Determine the suit used in the previous group
prev_group_start = (group - 1) * 3
prev_suit = mainline[prev_group_start].suit.suit_name
return card.suit.suit_name != prev_suit

rules_library.name: rank_is_power_of_two
rules_library.description: Only ranks that are powers of two (1, 2, 4, 8) may be played.
rules_library.code: return card.rank in (1,2,4,8)

rules_library.name: rank_equals_sum_of_last_three_mod13
rules_library.description: If at least three cards are on the mainline, the new rank must equal the sum of the last three ranks modulo 13 (0 treated as 13).
rules_library.code:
if len(mainline) < 3:
    return True
s = (mainline[-1].rank + mainline[-2].rank + mainline[-3].rank) % 13
expected = 13 if s == 0 else s
return card.rank == expected

rules_library.name: color_must_match_majority_of_last_five
rules_library.description: Look at the last up to five cards on the mainline; the new card must share the majority color among them. If there is a tie, any color is allowed.

rules_library.name: rank_is_greater_than_all_previous
rules_library.description: Each rank must be greater than or equal to every rank that has appeared earlier on the mainline.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
max_sofar = max(c.rank for c in mainline)
return card.rank >= max_sofar

rules_library.name: rank_is_less_than_all_previous
rules_library.description: Each rank must be less than or equal to every rank that has appeared earlier on the mainline.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
min_sofar = min(c.rank for c in mainline)
return card.rank <= min_sofar

rules_library.name: suit_must_be_different_from_last_two
rules_library.description: The card’s suit must differ from each of the previous two suits (if they exist).
rules_library.code:
if len(mainline) < 2:
    return True
prev1 = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
prev2 = mainline[-2].suit.suit_name
return card.suit.suit_name != prev1 and card.suit.suit_name != prev2

rules_library.name: rank_is_multiple_of_3_or_7
rules_library.description: Only ranks that are multiples of 3 or 7 (3, 6, 7, 9, 12) may be played.
rules_library.code: return card.rank % 3 == 0 or card.rank % 7 == 0

rules_library.name: rank_is_greater_than_last_even_if_last_is_king
rules_library.description: If the previous card is a King (13), any rank is allowed; otherwise the rank must be higher than the previous rank.

rules_library.name: rank_is_same_as_last_if_color_same_else_different
rules_library.description: If the new card’s color matches the previous card’s color, the rank must be identical; otherwise the rank must differ.

rules_library.name: face_cards_only
rules_library.description: Only face cards (Jack, Queen, King - ranks 11, 12, 13) may be played.
rules_library.code: return card.rank >= 11

rules_library.name: non_face_cards_only
rules_library.description: Only non-face cards (Ace through 10) may be played.
rules_library.code: return card.rank <= 10

rules_library.name: same_rank_as_last
rules_library.description: The card must have the same rank as the previous card.

rules_library.name: different_rank_from_last
rules_library.description: The card must have a different rank than the previous card.

rules_library.name: ranks_share_common_factor
rules_library.description: The card's rank and the previous card's rank must share a common factor greater than 1.

rules_library.name: ranks_coprime
rules_library.description: The card's rank and the previous card's rank must be coprime (share no common factors other than 1).

rules_library.name: rank_divides_or_divisible
rules_library.description: Either the card's rank divides the previous rank, or the previous rank divides the card's rank.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1].rank
return card.rank % prev == 0 or prev % card.rank == 0

rules_library.name: inverted_suit_matches_parity
rules_library.description: Red cards must have even ranks; black cards must have odd ranks.

rules_library.name: suit_differs_from_three_back
rules_library.description: The card's suit must differ from the suit of the card three positions earlier (if it exists).

rules_library.name: rank_between_last_two
rules_library.description: If at least two cards are on the mainline, the new rank must be between the last two ranks (inclusive).
rules_library.code:
if len(mainline) < 2:
    return True
lo = min(mainline[-1].rank, mainline[-2].rank)
hi = max(mainline[-1].rank, mainline[-2].rank)
return lo <= card.rank <= hi
